thread:
alex chen: FYI vendor just flagged a partial warranty swap for 12 of the 48 H100s we received last week. firmware mismatch + DOA rate ~8%. they want to RMA and ship replacements from their EU depot but there's a customs hold at CNH.

maria patel: Oof. prod-eu-west is already at ~85% GPU capacity, we can’t take another 12 out of rotation without rolling impact. which racks/serials are affected?

jordan li: Do we have spare loaners in DE/NL we can stage? If vendor can only do depot swap we need short-term top-up capacity.

ramon garcia (vendor): Sorry for the hit — we logged it as warranty swap ticket #V-9927. A few notes: customs flagged the shipment due to incorrect HS code on the commercial invoice; broker is holding AWB CNH-778210. We can either re-issue docs and pay brokerage to clear air (expedite) or route replacements from AMS depot (3d transit). Air expedite adds ~€6,000 + duties. We can provide provisional loaners (6 units) from nearby depot immediately under a depot voucher.

kevin ortiz: Ramon, who absorbs the expedite fee? Also confirm whether replacements are new sealed units or refurbished swaps. If refurbished, we need serial-level history.

ramon garcia (vendor): Replacements are new sealed units. For expedite fee: vendor can cover 50% if Redwood approves immediate air. Otherwise vendor ships AMS depot units with no extra fee but 72h ETA to our EU DC. Serial history will be attached momentarily.

supply-bot: New RMA created: V-9927. Manifest uploaded: manifest_v9927_2549997777.csv. Ticket link: https://vendor-portal.example.com/rma/V-9927

alex chen: We need list of affected serials now. Also put a serial embargo on those devices so DC doesn't re-kit them into loaner pool. If we pull from Dedicated spare pool, notify eng-sre.

maria patel: attaching minimal manifest snippet to help triage:

```
AWB: CNH-778210
Serials: RXC12345, RXC12346, RXC12347, RXC12348
PO: RW-2026-4109
Declared Value: 0 (warranty) - flagged by customs
```

jordan li: If we accept 6 provisional loaners from vendor, we can shift low-priority batch jobs to quantized variants for 24-48h and keep user-facing services stable. Can operations patch autoscaler to prevent eviction?

kevin ortiz: Finance input needed: we need sign-off for up to €6k expedite where vendor covers half. Jacob?

jacob finance: We can approve up to €8,000 for expedite if vendor pays 50%. Need a formal invoice update and a confirmation email from vendor acknowledging costs split and that replacements are new.

alex chen: Approved for 6 units air expedite under 50/50 cost share. Ramon, proceed with re-issuing commercial invoice with correct HS code and updated declared value "replacement units - no commercial sale", attach vendor PO and warranty letter. Also upload proof of insurance for the AWB.

ramon garcia (vendor): Roger. Re-issuing docs now. New AWB for air expedite (6 units): AWB-EU-45900231. Broker cleared AMS hold; remaining 6 will ship AMS-DC ground (72h). I'll tag depot-ams and clearance-broker in the portal. Insurance uploaded to ticket.

maria patel: Thanks. Ops — please hold redeploys on racks containing the affected serials until we confirm replacements arrived or LOA issued.

kevin ortiz: Logistics note: please route vendor invoices to finance@redwood.example and cc eng-ops so we can match expedite cost. Ramon, please include shipment weight and HS code 84733030.

ramon garcia (vendor): Done. Invoice update sent, AWB notes in ticket, and broker waiver requested. ETA air (6 units): 24-36h after clearance. ETA ground (6 units): 72h from AMS dispatch. Will update once flight manifests uploaded. :thumbsup:

alex chen: Great. Once the 6 air units scan into our AMS depot, ops please mark them as "provisional-loaners" with temporary tags and schedule a 48h soak before assigning to prod. We'll reconvene if customs reflags.

supply-bot: Ticket V-9927 status updated to "docs reissued by vendor" at 2549997905.

jacob finance: Received invoice update. I'll process a provisional payment hold for €3,000 pending vendor confirmation.

ramon garcia (vendor): Manifest + flight booking uploaded: FLT-908 / AWB-EU-45900231. Broker contact: ClearFast Logistics (clearfast@example.com).

alex chen: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up in ops standup tomorrow morning; please keep thread updated with scans and any customs change.

ramon garcia (vendor): Will do. tagging @depot-ams @clearance-broker in portal. Closing loop here after scans. :white_check_mark:
